source_facts.fact: xyd.mid.EXCHAGE_CODE_HERO = 241. GiftbagUseWindow and SelectEquipWindow submit item_id, gift_id and num; SelectSXHeroWindow submits num=1; ExchangeCodeHeroReward submits item_id and gift_id and consumes one source item.
Successful client callbacks remove the submitted source Backpack quantity locally, then pass response.awards to SelfPlayer:handleRewards; GiftbagUseWindow also passes response.spirit_awards.
BackpackWindow routes eight explicit item IDs to select_sx; select_equip routing comes from misc.select_equip_gift_ids; ordinary package opening uses the effective gift selection route.
GiftTable exposes ordinary item/scalar/drop fields but no equip accessor, while raw gift.lua contains nonzero equip metadata.

Fresh source census finds 199 previously ordinary-counted deterministic effective operations with nonzero raw gift.equip. Their materialization semantics are not source-bounded by the recovered client and therefore cannot safely be treated as empty/ordinary rewards.

Seven deterministic effective operations (item 50002146 gifts 90040415..90040420 and item 50002147 gift 90040421) point at item type 24 Horcrux/HUNQI rows while gift.item_nums is absent; generated/unique materialization remains deferred.

After correcting those two Pass136 modeling gaps, deterministic ordinary current-owner capability is 1,431 effective operations across 382 source items. The ordinary random lane remains 100 operations across 100 source items for Phase3.
